messages.subject: return nothing from reactvePrint()
parts:
I use reactivePrint() to call a function that prints all the necessary information.  I use invisible() in this function to return nothing, however there is still a line that says NULL in my output (presumably because NULL is passed back to reactivePrint()).  How can I get around this?

I'm printing a data frame with the command:   print(format(temp, width = name.width, justify = "centre"),row.names=FALSE,quote=FALSE)

I'm not sure how to return this, so I print it inside the function.  I do not wish for any output (including the NULL) to appear.

Thanks.
